$comment: Rock Solid Church's mobile app (decision 94). Rock ships no mobile application site, so the sample church adds its own. The loader writes the Site row (SiteType Mobile) with the two layouts and the homepage Rock seeds for a new app, the personal devices, and push history (docs/communications.md, Push). Pages, blocks, and app content come in later work.

devices.$comment: Designed shares (decision 161). About a quarter of active adults have the app, as Jon chose. Calibration part 7 measured 89% with notifications on, used here, and 94% on iPhone, from a church where only 1.4% of adults have the app, so the iPhone share is designed at 70%, like decision 101. Most devices were seen in the last month. Registration tokens start with sample-data-, so no push can ever reach a real phone (decision 95).

push.$comment: Pushes come from the push entries in content/communications/texts.json, to each campus's active adults with the app. The open rate is designed, because the measured church sent almost no pushes.
